title: orthosia misera
intro: Orthosia misera, commonly known as the Poor-man's-weather-glass or Poor Man's Weatherglass, is a type of flowering plant. The health benefits of Orthosia misera include its use in treating various respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma, as well as its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant involve its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve coughs, and aid in the treatment of various skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Orthosia misera include glycosides, saponins, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
